text: dsh-ponytail 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的提示词与技能插件，将七阶简化梯子注入系统提示词，并提供可调的 lite、full、ultra 强度和关闭模式。它注册六个技能，涵盖精简编码、过度设计评审、全仓审计、债务注释整理、基准收益展示和命令帮助；用户可用斜杠命令切换当前会话或持久默认等级。Web 配置卡可调整等级、逐项启停技能、切换技能描述语言并查看配置优先级。模式更新按会话追加提醒以保持原提示词基线稳定；无需额外 API Key。

dsh-ponytail adds a seven-rung coding prompt to DSH Web with lite, full, ultra, and off modes. Six skills cover coding guidance, reviews, audits, debt ledgers, benchmarks, and help. Slash commands change modes. The web card toggles skills and shows priority. Session updates append reminders.
想让代码助手先判断需求有没有必要，再给出尽量简单的实现。
有没有办法让 DSH 按轻量、标准或激进三种程度遵循简化原则？
我想给当前会话临时切换代码风格强度，不影响其他会话。
怎么把默认编码强度保存下来，让新会话也沿用？
帮我找代码评审里可以删掉的抽象、依赖和重复实现。
我需要对整个代码仓库做一次过度设计审计，并按可删内容排序。
能否把代码中的 ponytail 注释收集成一份待处理债务清单？
How can I keep a coding assistant focused on the smallest working solution?
Can I review a repository for over-engineering and get a ranked list of deletions?
How do I inspect the available modes and switch one for this session?
dsh-ponytail 的功能「七阶梯子」：SystemPrompt 按 full、lite、ultra 等级筛选提示内容；可从命令或配置更改强度。
dsh-ponytail 的功能「定向代码评审」：调用 ponytail-review 技能检查 diff 中可删除的抽象、依赖和复杂度，并输出逐行建议。
dsh-ponytail 的功能「全仓复杂度审计」：调用 ponytail-audit 扫描整个仓库，按可删除或简化的内容排序输出一次性报告。
dsh-ponytail 的功能「债务注释清单」：调用 ponytail-debt 收集仓库内 ponytail: 注释，整理简化项、上限和后续触发条件。
dsh-ponytail 的功能「基准收益看板」：调用 ponytail-gain 展示代码量、成本和速度的公开基准中位数，不计算单仓库节省值。
dsh-ponytail 的功能「模式与技能速查」：调用 ponytail-help 查看等级、六项技能、停用方式及默认等级配置路径。
dsh-ponytail 的功能「Web 配置卡」：插件详情配置卡可设默认模式、启停技能、选择描述语言、查看优先级并恢复默认。
配置走 DSH 设置服务并写入 profile 补丁；headless 或 CLI 则回退写入 profile 下的 ponytail/config.json。

The best code is the code you never wrote.

@wenaixi/dsh-ponytail README · dsh-ponytail：A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) port of [DietrichGebert/ponytail](https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail), maintained independently (ADR-0010). Injects the 7-rung ladder directly into system prompts, provides 6 specialized skills, and registers zero tools.

@wenaixi/dsh-ponytail README · What it is：A counter-weight to LLM boilerplate and over-engineering: deletion over addition, boring over clever, and fewest files possible. Challenge requirements before writing code (YAGNI), prioritize existing functions and standard libraries, and solve in one line when possible.

@wenaixi/dsh-ponytail README · What it is：Features a **Zero Cache Miss Architecture** (ADR-0012): session baseline is locked permanently, and dynamic intensity switches take effect via turn-end reminders, leaving historical prompt / KV cache 100% untouched across long conversations. Ships as a pure `dsh.bundle`, writes zero garbage to your home root, uninstalls cleanly, and rebuilds itself through HMR.

@wenaixi/dsh-ponytail README · Install：Needs the DSH runtime (`npm i -g @deepseek-ai/dsh`). Node and pnpm floors are in the badges above. Examples use the `web` profile; substitute your own profile name.

```bash
@wenaixi/dsh-ponytail README · Install (automatic HMR reload)：dsh plugin --profile web add @wenaixi/dsh-ponytail
@wenaixi/dsh-ponytail README · Remove：dsh plugin --profile web remove @wenaixi/dsh-ponytail

@wenaixi/dsh-ponytail README · Inspect composed patch tree：dsh --profile web --dump-config | grep -A2 ponytail
```

@wenaixi/dsh-ponytail README · Usage：```
/ponytail            Switch to full mode (all 7 rungs active)
/ponytail lite       Do the bare minimum
/ponytail ultra      Challenge the requirement itself first
/ponytail off        Disable injection

Intensity levels reset on each new session according to `env > Profile patch > fallback full`. Therefore, `/ponytail <level>` is session-scoped. To persist across restarts and new sessions, use `/ponytail default <level>`.

@wenaixi/dsh-ponytail README · Zero Cache Miss Architecture：When switching intensity levels within an ongoing session or updating global default configurations, the top-level SystemPrompt baseline remains **strictly byte-identical and static**.

@wenaixi/dsh-ponytail README · Zero Cache Miss Architecture：Mode transitions take effect dynamically by appending an incremental system notification (`<system-reminder>`) at the end of the current turn's user message (aligned with the official `dsh-tool-skill` catalog update pattern, ADR-0012). This **100% protects historical KV Cache / Prompt Cache** across all multi-turn conversation history, eliminating costly prefill recalculations and latency spikes.

@wenaixi/dsh-ponytail README · Skills：| Skill | Description |
|---|---|
| `/ponytail` | Core mode: 7-rung ladder, lazy senior dev mindset |
| `/ponytail-review` | Over-engineering code review: hunt for code that can be deleted |
| `/ponytail-audit` | Whole-repo complexity audit, ranked by deletion yield |
| `/ponytail-debt` | Harvest `ponytail:` comments into an actionable debt ledger |
| `/ponytail-gain` | Minimal metrics dashboard showing code reduction benchmarks |
| `/ponytail-help` | Quick reference card for modes, commands, and skills |

@wenaixi/dsh-ponytail README · Skill Bodies and Description Languages：Skill bodies are retrieved directly from upstream DietrichGebert/ponytail v4.10.3 in verbatim English. Two host-incompatible details are tailored for DSH: `ponytail-gain` data sources point to `assets/*.svg` (as upstream `benchmarks/` is excluded), and `ponytail-help` configuration and update sections reference profile patches and `dsh plugin`.

@wenaixi/dsh-ponytail README · Skill Bodies and Description Languages：Model catalog views and configuration forms share the exact same description string, governed by `skillDescriptionLang` (three-state: explicit Chinese `zh` / explicit English `en` / unconfigured `auto`). When unconfigured, it follows the host's `locale.preference` (English triggers English alignment; others default to Chinese). Explicit selection locks the language. Canonical descriptions reside in `skills/descriptions.zh.json` and `skills/descriptions.en.json`, served live via `ctx.remote.ponytail.snapshot()`.

@wenaixi/dsh-ponytail README · Configuration Panel：The card detail view provides an embedded settings panel: intensity level control, independent toggle switches for all 6 skills, a one-click reset button, and a 3-tier priority diagnostic chain displaying environment variables, profile patches, and built-in fallbacks with their active hit states.

@wenaixi/dsh-ponytail README · Configuration Panel：The level segmented control reflects only the actual persisted configuration. When `defaultMode` is not configured in the patch, the control highlights the appended `unset` segment. The currently active runtime level is displayed distinctly in the diagnostic header text.

Configuration reads and writes use two official DSH channels:

@wenaixi/dsh-ponytail README · Configuration Panel：| Channel | Scope | Target |
|---|---|---|
| `ctx.configForms.get('ponytail')` | Default level & disabled skills with revision conflict checking | `profiles/<name>/cordis.patch.yml` |
| `ctx.remote.ponytail.snapshot()` | Active runtime level & 3-tier diagnostic chain (read-only) | In-memory RPC |

Profiles lacking a full UI service bundle (headless, CLI) fall back gracefully to `profiles/<name>/ponytail/config.json`, fully aligned with the latest DSH pure profile architecture.
@wenaixi/dsh-ponytail README · Upstream Mapping：The six hooks from upstream `hooks/` are consolidated into a single DSH Cordis plugin:

@wenaixi/dsh-ponytail README · Upstream Mapping：| Upstream | DSH Implementation |
|---|---|
| `ponytail-config.js` | `src/ponytail-config.ts` |
| `ponytail-instructions.js` | `src/ponytail-instructions.ts` (single entrypoint `renderPromptSection`) |
| `ponytail-state.js` | `src/ponytail-state.ts` (flag file I/O, session baseline manager, reload) |
| `ponytail-activate.js` | `src/ponytail.ts` (`agent/created` hook) |
| `ponytail-mode-tracker.js` | `src/ponytail-commands.ts` (`createCommandDispatcher`) |
| `ponytail-subagent.js` | `src/ponytail.ts` (`agent/created`, `PONYTAIL_SUBAGENT_MATCHER`) |

@wenaixi/dsh-ponytail README · Upstream Mapping：Prompts are injected via `systemPrompt.section('ponytail')` at `order: 50`, positioned neatly between `persona` (0) and tools (100). When switched to `off`, prompt rendering overhead is zero. Flags and configurations are scoped per profile directory, ensuring full multi-instance isolation.

@wenaixi/dsh-ponytail README · Development：```bash
pnpm typecheck              # tsc --noEmit
pnpm build                  # tsc into lib/, scripts/build-client.mjs generates lib/client.js
node scripts/verify.mjs     # Static contract gates: artifacts, skills, zero tools, slots, locales
node scripts/docs-verify.mjs # Documentation and version consistency gates

最好的代码就是你从未写过的代码。

@wenaixi/dsh-ponytail README · dsh-ponytail：这是 [DietrichGebert/ponytail](https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail) 的 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）移植版，由我们独立维护（ADR-0010）。它把七阶梯子直接写进系统提示词，附带 6 个专项技能，不注册任何 tool。

@wenaixi/dsh-ponytail README · 它是什么：为了对抗 LLM 的样板代码和过度设计，我们提倡删减而非添加，追求无聊而非巧妙，文件越少越好。写代码之前先问一句这需求是否真的需要存在（YAGNI），优先复用已有的函数和标准库，能一行解决就别写五十行。

它还带一套**零缓存破坏架构**（ADR-0012）：会话的初始基线一旦确定就终身不变，运行中切换强度只靠在当前轮次末尾追加一条系统提醒生效，长对话里历史的 Prompt Cache / KV 缓存命中率始终保持在 100%。插件以纯净的 `dsh.bundle` 形式交付，不往你的家目录写任何垃圾文件，卸载时删得干干净净，改动通过 HMR 自动重载。

@wenaixi/dsh-ponytail README · 安装：需要先装 DSH 运行时（`npm i -g @deepseek-ai/dsh`），Node 和 pnpm 的最低版本见上方徽章。下面的示例用 `web` 这个 profile，换成你自己的 profile 名即可。

```bash
@wenaixi/dsh-ponytail README · 安装（自动触发 HMR 热重载）：dsh plugin --profile web add @wenaixi/dsh-ponytail

@wenaixi/dsh-ponytail README · 检查合成后的配置树：dsh --profile web --dump-config | grep -A2 ponytail
```

@wenaixi/dsh-ponytail README · 用法：```
/ponytail            切到 full（七阶梯子全开）
/ponytail lite       只做最低限度
/ponytail ultra      先挑战需求本身
/ponytail off        关闭注入

每次新会话启动时，强度会按 `env > Profile 补丁 > 内置兜底 full` 这条链重新确定，所以 `/ponytail <档>` 只在当前会话里有效。想让设置在重启和新会话之后依然保留，请用 `/ponytail default <档>`。

@wenaixi/dsh-ponytail README · 零缓存破坏架构：在会话进行中切换强度，或者修改全局默认配置时，顶层系统提示词基线保持**逐字节完全相同，不带任何变化**。

档位切换通过在当前轮次用户消息的末尾追加一条增量系统提醒（`<system-reminder>`）来动态生效，这套做法与官方 `dsh-tool-skill` 的目录更新范式一致（ADR-0012）。因此**历史的 KV Cache / Prompt Cache 被完整保护**，覆盖全部多轮对话历史，不会再为重新计算前缀付出高昂代价，也不会出现延迟尖峰。

@wenaixi/dsh-ponytail README · 包含技能：| 技能 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `/ponytail` | 核心模式：七阶梯子，资深懒人工程师的思维习惯 |
| `/ponytail-review` | 过度设计代码评审：专门找那些能删掉的代码 |
| `/ponytail-audit` | 全仓复杂度审计，按可删除的收益排序 |
| `/ponytail-debt` | 收集 `ponytail:` 注释，整理成可以执行的债务台账 |
| `/ponytail-gain` | 极简指标看板，展示代码缩减的实测基准 |
| `/ponytail-help` | 模式、命令与技能的速查卡 |

@wenaixi/dsh-ponytail README · 技能正文与描述语言：技能正文全部取自上游 DietrichGebert/ponytail v4.10.3，按原样保留英文。有两处内容在 DSH 里不适用，我们改成了真实的落点：`ponytail-gain` 的数据来源指向本仓的 `assets/*.svg`（上游的 `benchmarks/` 目录没有随仓库带过来），`ponytail-help` 的配置与更新章节改为介绍 profile 补丁和 `dsh plugin`。

模型目录和配置表单里看到的描述文字是同一个字符串，具体显示哪种语言由 `skillDescriptionLang` 决定，它有三种状态：显式中文 `zh`、显式英文 `en`、以及未配置的 `auto`。未配置时跟随宿主 `locale.preference` 的设置（选中英文就对齐英文，其他情况一律回落中文）。一旦显式选定，语言就锁定不变。两套描述的真源分别是 `skills/descriptions.zh.json` 和 `skills/descriptions.en.json`，通过 `ctx.remote.ponytail.snapshot()` 实时下发。

@wenaixi/dsh-ponytail README · 配置面板：已安装插件的卡片详情里内嵌了一块配置面板，包含强度等级控制、6 个技能各自的独立开关、一键重置按钮，以及一条三级优先级诊断链，逐项显示环境变量、profile 补丁和内置兜底当前的值与是否生效。

等级分段控件只反映真正持久化下来的配置。如果补丁里没有写 `defaultMode`，控件就会高亮末尾追加的那一段 `unset`。当前实际运行的等级则单独显示在诊断区的标题文字里，两者不会混淆。

配置的读取和写入走 DSH 的两条官方通道：

| 通道 | 范围 | 落点 |
|---|---|---|
| `ctx.configForms.get('ponytail')` | 默认等级与禁用的技能，写入时自带 revision 冲突检测 | `profiles/<name>/cordis.patch.yml` |
| `ctx.remote.ponytail.snapshot()` | 当前运行的等级与三级诊断链（只读） | In-memory RPC |
@wenaixi/dsh-ponytail README · 配置面板：如果某个 profile 没有完整的 UI 服务组合（比如 headless、CLI 这类环境），配置会自动平稳回退到 `profiles/<name>/ponytail/config.json`，与最新的 DSH 纯净 profile 架构完全一致。

@wenaixi/dsh-ponytail README · 上游映射：| 上游 | DSH 中的实现 |
|---|---|
| `ponytail-config.js` | `src/ponytail-config.ts` |
| `ponytail-instructions.js` | `src/ponytail-instructions.ts`（单一出口 `renderPromptSection`） |
| `ponytail-state.js` | `src/ponytail-state.ts`（flag 文件读写、会话基线管理、重载） |
| `ponytail-activate.js` | `src/ponytail.ts`（`agent/created` 钩子） |
| `ponytail-mode-tracker.js` | `src/ponytail-commands.ts`（`createCommandDispatcher`） |
| `ponytail-subagent.js` | `src/ponytail.ts`（`agent/created`、`PONYTAIL_SUBAGENT_MATCHER`） |
@wenaixi/dsh-ponytail README · 上游映射：提示词通过 `systemPrompt.section('ponytail')` 注入，位置在 `order: 50`，正好夹在 `persona`（0）和工具（100）之间。切到 `off` 之后，生成提示词的开销为零。标志文件和配置都按 profile 目录各自保存，多实例之间完全隔离。
